scenario.zh: 为创作者提供音乐生成工具,同时通过归因技术追踪原始素材来源,确保版权所有者获得认可
scenario.en: Provides music generation tools for creators while tracking original source material through attribution technology to ensure rights holders receive credit

instruction.zh: 描述你想要的音乐风格和情绪
instruction.en: Describe the music style and mood you want

output.zh: 生成驱动力强的律动和低音线条
output.en: Generates driving rhythms with bass lines

input.zh: 深沉科技舞曲,140 BPM,工业氛围,重复合成器模式,低音驱动
input.en: Deep techno track, 140 BPM, industrial atmosphere, repetitive synth patterns, bass-driven

output.zh: 四层结构:底鼓和低音基础,合成器循环层,打击乐纹理,环境效果。需在GasLab平台生成音频
output.en: Four-layer structure: kick and bass foundation, synth loop layer, percussion texture, ambient effects. Audio generation requires GasLab platform

output.zh: 创建空间感和演变的音景

input.zh: 氛围电子乐,缓慢发展,柔和合成器铺垫,细微纹理变化
input.en: Ambient electronic, slow development, soft synth pads, subtle texture shifts

output.zh: 三段式发展:开场铺垫建立,中段引入旋律片段,结尾渐隐。需在GasLab平台生成音频
output.en: Three-part development: opening pad establishment, middle melodic fragments, fade-out ending. Audio generation requires GasLab platform

instruction.zh: 查看生成音乐的来源识别结果
instruction.en: Review source identification for generated music

output.zh: 显示训练数据中识别的原始作品和创作者(示例数据)
output.en: Shows identified original works and creators from training data (example data)

input.zh: 8小节科技舞曲,包含合成器模式和鼓组编排
input.en: 8-bar techno segment with synth pattern and drum arrangement

output.zh: 归因记录显示潜在来源(虚构示例)
output.en: Attribution record shows potential sources (fictional example)

detail.zh: 检测到与特定科技舞曲制作人风格相似的元素(虚构)
detail.en: Detected elements similar to specific techno producer style (fictional)

detail.zh: 识别出常见的工业科技舞曲节奏框架(虚构)
detail.en: Identified common industrial techno rhythm framework (fictional)

detail.zh: 系统标记潜在相关的创作者以供审核(虚构)
detail.en: System flags potentially related creators for review (fictional)

takeaway.zh: 演示了从创作描述到归因追踪的流程概念,实际音频生成、版权验证和报酬分配需在GasLab平台完成
takeaway.en: Illustrated the flow concept from creative brief to attribution tracking; actual audio generation, rights verification, and compensation require the GasLab platform
